content: Mëuesadaid Esusën bëdamiaid
Adashic padpidec Nuquin Papan chiaid chuibante shubun Esus puduedpondash. Ambo dada mëuesadaid tsadnubi

Esus chieshënquid padiseyobo dadpen tabadpondash. Adec tabadec, Nëbi chonoadtemaid ushë icnuda Esusën mëuesadaid bëdamepeque. Nëid badiadën bëdamesho isun bedmeshun quënën nauedmenu quetsëcquiec padiseyobo tabadcuededpondash.
Aden tantiec padiseyobo tabadnubien mëuesadaid chuiquin Esusën: —Nënantanquio nidto —capondash.

Adoac nënantanquio nidtoash mëuesadaid nidnubi iccuededquido chiec Esus onquepondash: —¿Chonoadtemaid ushën matses tantiaquindambi nape? ¿Adoenquiocquin matses icsa uapendambi ique? ¿Nëid ushëndambi matses bëdamepe? ¿Bëdamenquiocquindambi cuesunepe? —quepondash. Aden chiec Esus onquenubien onquenquio yec tabadpondash padiseyobo.

Adoaquien nëishtanquimbi abi chieshënquido bëisbanec Esus, Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiabanquin naisa yec pausudtiapimbo icquido nec, abibi quiashic, Unësquio iquebi, quec tsadpondash. Adec tsadquin mëuesadaid chuiquin Esusën: —Ëbi mëd —cac mëdequi bëdampondash.

Adosho isash puduenanec nidquin edodesbo padiseyobon badedquio istuidpondash. Aido istuidash: —Esus cuesunete mibi bunacpadquiec bunebi. ¿Mitsipadentsimbi cuesunemenuen bedmepeba? —quecuededpondash padiseyobo.
Esus yacno matses dadpen choaid
Adnubien Esusbëd 12ted icquido chian Cadidia caid yacno nidoapondash. Adnubien nidaid Cadidia caid yacnoësh utsibo dadpen cho-choapondash.

Adnubien Esusën nabansho isboedon chiac nidaid Udeya caid yacnocquido dadpen cho-chonobi adecbidi Edusaden yacnocquido cho-chonobi adecbidi Idumeya yacnocquido cho-chonobi adecbidi acte Odan caid uquë cuëma utsiucquido cho-chonobi adecbidi shubu dadpen icquid Tido caid yacnocquido cho-chonobi adecbidi shubu dadpen icquid Sidon caid yacnocquido cho-chopondash. Esus yacno ambi nabanaid utsibon chuisho tantiash cho-chopondash.
Adec cho-choash tsucus-tsucustsëcquio yec tabadquin tsicatiac nënantanquio tsadacnoëshi catashnushe quiash Esus: —Cano bec cho —quiampondash abëd icquidquio caic.
Dadpen bëdamiosh cadoshe. Ëbitsen bëdanu quequin ambibi tantiaquin Esus mishbededpondash.
Adembidi tantiaquin mishnuec mayan icsa dapuduedaid choquin Esus istuidequi uebudec comapenec sidquianec: —Nuquin Papan madombobi mibi nec —quec comapenec cuëdpondash.
Adoaquien: —Padi. Aden ëbi chienda —quepondash Esus.
Abëd 12ted icquid Esusën tantiamenu caid
Adashic macuësh dapa yacno nidnushi abëd 12ted icquido chomeshun nadopondash:
Ëmbi tantiacpadomboen mibitedi tantiamembi. Adquid icquin ëbëd tabadquin ëmbi chiacpadomboen mimbi tantiabenendac. Aden tantiabenacsho isun ëmbi chiacpadomboen chuimenuen mibitsen nidmembi.
Adembidi mayan icsa dapuduedaid dapuduemequidbidi mibi icmembi quequin abëd icquido Esusën chuipondash.
Ambi tantiamenu caid nëidtedi icpondash: Simon cashumbic Esusën Petedo capondash,
utsibic Sebedeyon mado daëd, Acobobëd Uan. Aid daëdi, abu cuëdtequidën mado nec quequin oncain Buanedquis quequin Esusën cuëmpondash.

Utsibic Andedes, utsibic Uedipe, utsibic Badtodome, utsibic Mateyo cuënshumbic Debi cuëmpondash. Utsibic Tomas, utsibic Acobo, aidi Adpeon mado nepondash. Utsibic Tadeyo, utsibic Simon, aidi cananistabo caidbidi nepondash.
Utsibic Udas Iscadiote, aidi abi chieshënquido Esus bedmenush Esusbëd capuquid nepondash. Aidtedi Esusën tantiamequin chuiquin ismiaido niondash.
Bedtsibu caidën dausunaid Esus nec quiaid
Aidtedi chianec nidequi Esusbëd icquido shubun puduedpondash. Shubun puduednubien matses dadpen cho-choapondash. Adshobien Esusën Nuquin Papan chiaid chuibanubi Esusbëd icquidon penquio icpondash.
Aden penquiocsho isanec nidshun Esus yuedquid yacno choshon chuituidpondash. Aden chuituidac anocquidtsen Esus bednuec chopondash. Icsabudashien nec quianec chopondash.

Adomboembidi Esus icsabudec quequin icsamboen chuiquid utsibo icpondash. Isadaidbo tsusedpabon nadomboen nata quequin chiaid tantiamequid chuiquid dapabo niondash. Aido Edusaden caid yacnoësh choquido niondash. Aido mayan icsa Esusën dapuduemesho isboed Esus chieshënquid yec nadpondash: —Mayan icsan icbo Satanas cashumbic Bedtsibu caidën tantiamiaid Esus nec. Adquid icquin mayan icsa matses dapuduedaid dapuduemec —quepondash.
Adoaquien Esus: —Mimbi icsamboen tantieque. Mibi chuibanu. Tantiec tabadta. ¿Mayan icsan icbo ambi dapuduedmiaid dapuduemequidta nepadic? Padenquio.
Adquiecbidi shubu icbo abëd icquido cuëshëdmesa nec.
Icbon abëd icquido cuëshëdmiash shubu abentsëquën tabadtiapimbo iquendac.
Adembidi ambi dapuduedmiaid dapuduemiash adquidën icbo ictiapimbo Satanas iquec. Icbo icnuequid abëd icquid puduemesa nec.

Dadpenshun icbo Satanas nec. Adquid icquin ambi matses dapuduedmiaid dëniacanquidënuidquio nadatiambocquin nabanquin cuemepec. Adquid icquin ëmbi nac mayan icsa dapuduedaid Satanasën yua icboedi icbombo tantiec bëdambo yanec ëbëd iquendac.

Abimbo chiembique. Tantiata. Matses cuidenquiocquin abi icsaid bëpiscudquin paucquid Nuquin Papa nendac. Adecbidi Nuquin Papa icsamboen chuiboedi, Icsaobi, Papa, quesho tantiashun Nuquin Papan aid pauquendac.
Utsien Nuquin Papan Mayan abipadquidën tantiamiac nasho isun Satanasën naid nec quesho pauquenquio iquendac. Adquid ënëdenquio yec icsaquid nendac —quepondash Esus
Satanasën tantiamiac mayan icsa dapudemequid Esus nec abi caquido chiec.
Esus yacno aton utsibo anibëd choaid
Adashic Esus yacno aton utsibo anibëd chopondash. Aido choshon matses dadpen nuntan tabadsho istuidash: —Ëbi choaid con mado chuita —quepondash utsi chiec.
Adoac puduedshun Esus nënantan tsadsho isun: —Titabëd min utsibo choshon umanucshun mibi isnuen cainec —quequin chuituidpondash.
Adoaquien Esus: —Adquid utsi chuinu. Tantiata.
Në tabadquido ëbëd icquido neque. Is —quepondash Esus abëd iccuededquido chiec.
Adashic: —Nuquin Papan chiacpadomboen nabanquid ëbëd icquid nec. Adquid buchi caindambi. Adquid chido chuchu caindambi. Adquid utsi tita caindambi —quepondash Esus.
